events.title: Nokia Lumia 800 released
events.summary: Nokia released the Nokia Lumia 800 — first Nokia Windows Phone — Mango-era Metro [UI] hardware.
events.about: Nokia hardware shaped pre-iPhone smartphones and later Microsoft's mobile platform bet. First nokia windows phone — mango-era metro ui hardware.

narrative.whyChosen: The Nokia Lumia 800 was a flagship Nokia smartphone milestone.
narrative.whyImportant: Nokia devices defined mobile platforms from Symbian through Windows Phone.
narrative.problemSolved: Mobile users needed capable smartphones before the iPhone/Android era matured.

events.title: Galaxy Nexus released
events.summary: Google began selling the Galaxy [Nexus] — first phone with [Android] 4.0 Ice Cream Sandwich.
events.about: [Nexus] and [Pixel] phones were Google's pure-[Android] reference hardware for developers. First phone with android 4.0 ice cream sandwich. [AOSP] builds and CTS testing often used [Pixel] devices as the baseline.

narrative.whyChosen: The Galaxy [Nexus] was a flagship Google [Android] reference device.
narrative.whyImportant: [Pixel]/[Nexus] hardware defines the reference [Android] experience for developers.
narrative.problemSolved: [Android] needed first-party reference phones without [OEM] skin fragmentation.
